scope: M1 Windows phase 1; standalone packaging, not wired into default CMake or CI (decision 8 excluded).

host.name: subrec-asr.exe
host.api: C API only; use include/sherpa-onnx/c-api/c-api.h from the Windows full package; no fallback needed

vad_selection.status: RESERVED ONLY. The file that actually ships is not selected until S0 A/B is approved (decision 10). Assembly defaults to no VAD; explicit --vad v6.2.3 requires file SHA256 verification. Do not track v6.3/master.

sensevoice.policy: SenseVoice-Small int8 is downloaded by ModelManager only after FunASR Model License 1.1 acceptance.

sherpa-windows.variant: Windows x64 shared-MT Release no-tts FULL package
sherpa-windows.sha256_provenance: Verified file SHA256 matches GitHub API digest; official checksum.txt does not list Windows tar.bz2.
sherpa-windows.role: build inputs; ship only the runtime allowlist

vad-v4-sherpa.role: S0 A/B only; NOT the installer default; assembly does not accept this candidate

vad-v6.2.3.git_blob_provenance: Matches contents API; this is NOT the file SHA256.
vad-v6.2.3.role: RESERVED for installer after S0 A/B approval (decision 10); not finalized

verification_context.downloads: Previously fetched outside the repo; do not commit archives, DLLs, ONNX files or unpacked packages.

windows_header.comparison: Identical to /workspace/projects/pkgC-verify/include/sherpa-onnx/c-api/c-api.h from Linux v2.0.2 except CRLF vs LF.
windows_header.hash_note: Existing verification results, not file SHA256 values; difference is line endings.

runtime.source: lib/ of the verified full Windows package
runtime.bin_contents: onnxruntime.dll, onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll and many sherpa-onnx-*.exe CLI tools

pe_imports.onnxruntime.dll_note: Does not import onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll at load time.

runtime.providers_shared_reason: Present in the official package and small; include defensively even though it is not an onnxruntime load-time import.
runtime.verification_limit: Only archive SHA256 and individual DLL sizes are pinned here. Assembly expects an unmodified extraction of the verified archive; size checks do not authenticate individual DLL contents or the built host.

onnxruntime.LICENSE.provenance: github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime and raw.githubusercontent.com returned 404 from the fetching network; jsDelivr served the v1.28.2 file. No new network verification in phase 1.

license_copy_policy: Original bytes from /workspace/projects/pkgC-verify-win/licenses-src/ copied into packaging/licenses/asr/ and installed into payload licenses/asr/ with a SubRec bundle NOTICE.txt, including the reserved Silero license even when VAD is absent.
